rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for joy or delight, especially delight at one's own good fortune.

example.english: They were full of glee after winning the prize.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung3 zo2 zoeng2 mun5 min6 hei2 jyut6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the glee comes from seeing someone else suffer or fail.

example.english: They laughed with glee when their rival lost.
example.traditional: 見到對頭輸咗，佢仲幸災樂禍咁笑。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 deoi3 tau4 syu1 zo2 keoi5 zung6 hang6 zoi1 lok6 wo6 gam3 siu3
